metadata.description: YapCut by alexmuresan.com: a measured-first short-form content engine for Claude Code. Outlier Radar interviews a creator once (audience, proof, voice corpus), then each week reads last week's numbers, finds rising mechanics and writes gated scripts and LinkedIn posts to filming slots on a tracked dashboard. The Lead Magnet Report turns one category's measured data into a comment-gated document post. The TikTok Yap Editor turns raw phone clips into finished vertical video with an edit record that joins the cut to the post.

plugins.name: outlier-radar
plugins.description: Weekly viral-outlier research and script engine, measured-first, plus the Lead Magnet Report. 3.5: an audience block and a proof-extraction interview at onboarding, filming slots instead of a script bar, a real gate runner with one exit contract, tracking and a people ledger on disk, the distribution doctrine shipped, LinkedIn craft and the carousel renderer moved in, a law.md overlay for the creator's own rulings. Data lives in a local workspace plugin updates never touch.

plugins.name: tiktok-yap-editor
plugins.description: Turn raw phone clips into finished vertical video for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn. 3.1: one gate ladder for both modes with a single exit contract, a static first frame, a hook word gate and hook variants, per-platform re-composes, an edit record that joins the cut to the post, a footage library with reconcile, a shared library with one brand resolver and no skill-root config.
